features.name: Stale install & public reference data channel (schema 2)
behaviors: Installed wheel runs from site-packages, never the repo checkout
agentcompass data --refresh downloads and activates sha256+schema-2 verified reference data under ROUTER_STATE_DIR/public-data/sets/<version>
Tampered sha256 and corrupt JSON are rejected without overwriting the active set
A 0.3.5 install (schema 1) fetching schema-2 public data returns schema_too_new and keeps its bundled set without error
agentcompass doctor reports Reference data: fetched <version> (..., schema 2, ...)
AGENTCOMPASS_PUBLIC_DATA=off pins source to bundled and reports - channel off in doctor

features.name: Fleet parity on a clean install without accounts.local.json
behaviors: No accounts.local.json exists in the built wheel or foreign profile
Clean discovered accounts route across bounded_coding, deep_debugging, and frontend_visual task archetypes with positive scores

features.name: Classifier cascade across multi-home accounts and families
behaviors: When JEV_API_KEY is absent and ~/.claude is signed out while ~/.claude-2 is signed in, score_task skips jev and ~/.claude and classifies with claude_haiku_low on account claude-2
When all Claude homes are signed out, score_task cascades to codex_terra_low on codex-2 without failing

features.name: Quota, window scope, gate parity, control messages, model management & twin suppression
behaviors: Pi signed into the same Codex subscription account_id produces no twin bundles alongside codex
Antigravity 3p windows on a template-only host have positive capacity priced from the pool prior
On Antigravity with 3p-weekly used up, a Gemini launch is allowed and a Claude-model launch is blocked by both routing and router_gate_hook
A 5h window at its floor blocks a new launch for claude, codex, and claude-2 (100% blocks all; 75% blocks claude/claude-2 Pro 25% floor)
Active in-flight ledger reservations count against quota in router_gate_hook and secondary Claude accounts not named claude-2 resolve from bundle/labels
A Magpie pool with accounts: 2 is judged on N*(100-mean)
A new data-declared scoped window works with zero code change
The owning parent's control message to its running worker on an exhausted window passes, while messages to idle, unknown-status, and non-owner workers are blocked

Superseded discovered models default to unchecked, latest & unknown new models default to checked, user checkbox overrides both ways, tray agrees with routing, and checked metered models are chosen only when no subscription is eligible

features.name: Antigravity plan tier from Google loadCodeAssist
behaviors: antigravity_plan resolves tier ('ultra') from loadCodeAssist using agy's keyring token
antigravity-plan.json is cached under ROUTER_STATE_DIR without leaking the OAuth token
AGENTCOMPASS_ANTIGRAVITY_PLAN=off disables the Google tier lookup

features.name: Magpie gateway pools & stale reading POST refresh
behaviors: Auto-discovered Magpie gateway calls POST /v1/magpie/quotas/refresh for hours-old readings on force=True
Largest plan wins and shows pool multiplier 'pro ×2' with window labels '7d×2' and '5h×2'
usage_details.members masks account emails (a***@...) and never stores raw emails or tokens

features.name: Stranger account topologies & setup/discovery/uninstall home parity
behaviors: Across only-Claude, only-Codex, Magpie-Claude, agy-not-signed-in, no-Paseo, and Paseo custom CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR + 2-hop extends chain profiles, setup writes rules/skills/hooks to the exact set of homes provider_inventory.discover() finds
Each Claude/Codex home keeps its own settings (model, effortLevel, env) when setup adds the gate hook, and uninstall restores them unchanged
agentcompass uninstall --yes removes every setup-created file and restores pre-existing files unchanged
Re-running setup --yes --hooks after a previously managed custom home is retired cleans up its managed doc/hook/skill link and drops it from setup-manifest.json
only-Claude and only-Codex profiles classify and route cleanly without Paseo or API keys

features.name: Tray account cards & hover + usage-float standalone and hosted rows
behaviors: agentcompass setup --usage-float clones usage-float into ~/.agent-compass/plugins/usage-float
Tray account_cards() shows remaining_pct, 'pro ×2', '7d×2'/'5h×2' tags, no window tag on week-only accounts, and masked member hover tooltip
Hosted usage-float shares ~/.agent-compass/usage-cache.json, displays left_pct=150%/100% on ×2 pools, titles week-only accounts without a '7d' suffix, and renders masked member hover detail
usage_float.parse_claude_usage sets models=['sonnet'] on weekly_sonnet and window_scope.binds scopes it to Sonnet only

features.name: Real machine isolation & process hygiene
behaviors: Real user profile files (~/.agent-compass, ~/.claude*, ~/.codex*, ~/.paseo) are unpolluted
No background process started inside the foreign-machine sandbox remains running

features.name: Evidence-calibrated routing after 0.3.6
behaviors: On a first scan a model public data lists in `superseded` (an older Haiku beside Haiku 5.5) is discovered unchecked and its successor checked
Metered accounts are a last resort (excluded while a subscription can take the work, chosen only when none can) and never-billed (unknown billing) accounts are explicit selection only
Frontier work routes only to a bundle at or above scoring.ability_floor.frontier; when only lower models have quota it returns none with needs_user_decision and next_reset instead of downgrading
A scoring.ability_floor or scoring.route_ability_floor value in accounts-override.json changes the installed CLI's plan
A model row's fixed_effort (Grok Bot) is the scored effort and its routed bundle carries no effort
The free-usage bonus applies only on the account public data declares it for (Dot), not on another free account running the same model
A Magpie pool of N accounts forecasts demand against N x 100% (remaining above one account's 100% does not hide other work's draw) and its reset is the members' later reset

The tray ability-floor chart places every bundle at the installed allocator's ability, save_ability_floors writes only numbers the router then reads, restore_ability_floor_defaults removes them, and AbilityFloorRenderer renders off-screen
Every check above is run once more against data broken inside the throwaway profile and must fail there

features.name: Oh My Pi OAuth subscription logins
behaviors: An enabled omp OAuth login (agent.db auth_credentials) signed in as the native Codex account is a subscription account whose quota_account is that account, and discovery output carries no omp token or email
Its bundles sit on the Codex account with omp's `<provider>/<model>` launch ids and no twin of a (harness, model, effort)
The plan treats an omp subscription bundle like Pi's: eligible, drawing the shared Codex window, excluded when that window is empty
With only subscription logins (no models.yml, no stored API key) there is no metered `omp` account in discovery or routing; a stored API key keeps it beside the login
An omp-only login is its own subscription account on the Codex plan's windows with omp bundles
A disabled credential is ignored; two logins of one provider are two accounts; a corrupt or locked agent.db is missing_credentials, not a crash
Every check above is run once more against broken input inside the throwaway profile and must fail there
